Domain: Physical — Resource: Stamina — Specialty: Lock — Specialty Condition: Lock

Ranged combat, precision, projectile control, and sustained targeting — firearms, bows, crossbows, thrown weapons, launchers, or energy weapons.

Lock

When using a Ballistics Action against a detected creature with a clear firing solution, burn 1 additional die to establish Lock on it before the Action resolves. You may maintain only one Lock at a time; establishing a new one ends the previous. A Lock ends if the target remains completely outside your line of sight through the end of your Turn.

  • Trajectory
